title: Indian Oil Giant ONGC Eyes Return to Syrian Operations
summary: India’s state-run Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) has said it is prepared to restart upstream operations in Syria once “normalcy” returns, according to The National. Executives from ONGC Videsh Ltd, the company’s overseas arm, confirmed they are monitoring developments closely and would move to re-enter the Syrian sector if political stability and security conditions permit. The disclosure marks the first public signal in over a decade that ONGC could resume activities in Syria, where it previously held stakes in…

title: Trump: Saudi Arabia Will Invest $600B in America "And It Could Go Even Higher"
summary: President Trump announced that Saudi Arabia has agreed to invest $600 billion into the United States, adding that the total could increase depending on future negotiations. The commitment underscores deepening U.S.–Saudi economic ties and marks one of the largest investment pledges ever discussed between the two nations.In addition, President Trump disclosed ongoing negotiations to approve export licenses for advanced semiconductor chips to Saudi Arabia, signaling expanded U.S.-Saudi cooperation in artificial intelligence technology and chip manufacturing capabilities.submitted by/u/MarketFlux[link][comments]
